title: Drop and Protocol
author: Bram Coldharbour
blurb: Emrys Pemberton, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
